title: Zebra waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f7f7ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d9dcf0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stripe' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#3b3560'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#232042'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='hoof' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5a5470'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3b3555'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='mane' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4a4278'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2e2a50'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='muzzle' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8d93b5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6e739b'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x='30' y='66' width='8' height='28' rx='4' fill='url(#body)'/>

  <!-- leg stripes -->
  <rect x='30' y='72' width='8' height='4' fill='url(#stripe)'/>
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='8' height='4' fill='url(#stripe)'/>
  <rect x='42' y='76' width='8' height='4' fill='url(#stripe)'/>
  <rect x='42' y='86' width='8' height='4' fill='url(#stripe)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='72' width='8' height='4' fill='url(#stripe)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='82' width='8' height='4' fill='url(#stripe)'/>
  <rect x='72' y='76' width='8' height='4' fill='url(#stripe)'/>
  <rect x='72' y='86' width='8' height='4' fill='url(#stripe)'/>

  <rect x='29' y='90' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='url(#hoof)'/>

  <rect x='59' y='90' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='url(#hoof)'/>

  <ellipse cx='55' cy='58' rx='30' ry='20' fill='url(#body)'/>

  <path d='M32 44 Q40 58 32 72 L38 73 Q46 58 38 43 Z' fill='url(#stripe)'/>
  <path d='M46 40 Q54 58 46 76 L52 77 Q60 58 52 39 Z' fill='url(#stripe)'/>

  <path d='M78 42 Q86 58 79 72 L85 71 Q92 58 84 43 Z' fill='url(#stripe)'/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
